POSIX_DEVICE_IO

Enable this option group with CONFIG_POSIX_DEVICE_IO.

Note

When using Newlib, Picolibc, or other C libraries conforming to the ISO C Standard, the C89 components of the POSIX_DEVICE_IO Option Group are considered supported.
